title: Not applied to non-text modalities
description: The Transformer has been demonstrated only on text translation tasks; it has not yet been extended to problems involving images, audio, or video.
canonical_description: model not evaluated on non-text modalities

evidence.quote: We plan to extend the Transformer to problems involving input and output modalities other than text and to investigate local, restricted attention mechanisms to efficiently handle large inputs and outputs such as images, audio and video.
